title: Index cards: measuring a memory layer for coding agents
summary: A memory layer for coding agents: code keeps one markdown card per person and project, listing every dated note that mentions it, so an agent on a small context budget can follow a question across two notes. Benchmarked against grep, BM25, embeddings, hybrid retrieval and a Claude Code style memory file at an equal context budget.
